parsed.ceo_summary: We will enhance our CI pipeline robustness by deploying a minimal, highly observable API service to ensure faster, more reliable smoke test verification.
constraints: • Implement a minimal HTTP echo server endpoint.
• Integrate structured logging (e.g., JSON format) for all verification events.
• Ensure the service is lightweight and has minimal overhead.
• Define clear API contracts for CI consumers.
• Ensure robust error handling within the server logic.
parsed.cpo_summary: The product shape will be a minimal API service focusing purely on echo functionality and structured logging to ensure rapid feasibility and low maintenance overhead.
parsed.rationale: An API service is the most suitable modality as it allows the creation of a lightweight, decoupled HTTP echo server that can be easily integrated into a CI pipeline for verification, fulfilling the requirement for a headless service.

parsed.cto_summary: We will deploy a highly efficient C++ service to provide rapid, observable smoke test verification within the CI pipeline.
